entries.title: Job 9:1
segments: ¶Then Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 9:2
segments: I know [it is] so of a truth: but how should man be just with God? {with God: or, before God?}

entries.title: Job 9:3
segments: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.

entries.title: Job 9:4
segments: [He is] wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened [himself] against him, and hath prospered?

entries.title: Job 9:5
segments: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.

entries.title: Job 9:6
segments: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.

entries.title: Job 9:7
segments: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.

entries.title: Job 9:8
segments: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea. {waves: Heb. heights}

entries.title: Job 9:9
segments: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south. {Arcturus...: Heb. Ash, Cesil, and Cimah}

entries.title: Job 9:10
segments: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.

entries.title: Job 9:11
segments: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see [him] not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

entries.title: Job 9:12
segments: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou? {hinder...: Heb. turn him away?}

entries.title: Job 9:13
segments: [If] God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him. {proud...: Heb. helpers of pride, or, strength}

words.text: under him. {proud...: Heb. helpers of pride, or, strength}

entries.title: Job 9:14
segments: ¶How much less shall I answer him, [and] choose out my words [to reason] with him?

entries.title: Job 9:15
segments: Whom, though I were righteous, [yet] would I not answer, [but] I would make supplication to my judge.

entries.title: Job 9:16
segments: If I had called, and he had answered me; [yet] would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.

entries.title: Job 9:17
segments: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.

entries.title: Job 9:18
segments: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.

entries.title: Job 9:19
segments: If [I speak] of strength, lo, [he is] strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time [to plead]?

entries.title: Job 9:20
segments: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: [if I say], I [am] perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.

words.text: , it shall also prove me perverse

entries.title: Job 9:21
segments: [Though] I [were] perfect, [yet] would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

entries.title: Job 9:22
segments: ¶This [is] one [thing], therefore I said [it], He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

entries.title: Job 9:23
segments: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

entries.title: Job 9:24
segments: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, [and] who [is] he?

entries.title: Job 9:25
segments: ¶Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.

entries.title: Job 9:26
segments: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle [that] hasteth to the prey. {swift...: or, ships of Ebeh: Heb. ships of desire}

words.text: . {swift...: or, ships of Ebeh: Heb. ships of desire}

entries.title: Job 9:27
segments: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort [myself]:

entries.title: Job 9:28
segments: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

words.text: that thou wilt not hold me innocent

entries.title: Job 9:29
segments: [If] I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?

entries.title: Job 9:30
segments: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

entries.title: Job 9:31
segments: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me. {abhor...: or, make me to be abhorred}

words.text: me. {abhor...: or, make me to be abhorred}

entries.title: Job 9:32
segments: For [he is] not a man, as I [am, that] I should answer him, [and] we should come together in judgment.

words.text: , as I [am, that] I should answer

entries.title: Job 9:33
segments: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, [that] might lay his hand upon us both. {any...: Heb. one that should argue} {daysman: or, umpire}

words.text: . {any...: Heb. one that should argue} {daysman: or, umpire}

entries.title: Job 9:34
segments: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

words.text: from me, and let not his fear

entries.title: Job 9:35
segments: [Then] would I speak, and not fear him; but [it is] not so with me. {it is...: Heb. I am not so with myself}

words.text: him; but [it is] not so with me. {it is...: Heb. I am not so with myself}
